prompt:
The snippet snippets/password-page-labels.liquid renders the login panel of the storefront password page. It reads no variables. It was migrated from an older theme, and all of its literal references are stale. Theme Check reports missing assets, missing translation keys and missing snippets. Fix only the literal operands so that every reference resolves to something that exists in this theme. Read the provided assets/, locales/ and snippets/ files first. Do not change the markup, attributes or element order.

Required mapping, by purpose. All translation keys live under the nested namespace `general.password_page` in the locale files:
1. The stylesheet must be the password section stylesheet in assets/. Do not use the newsletter stylesheet.
2. The lock icon must render the padlock icon snippet in snippets/.
3. The heading must use the login form heading key.
4. The label must use the login form password label key.
5. The input placeholder must use the login form password placeholder key.
6. The submit button must use the login form submit key.
7. The paragraph must use the admin link key.
8. The social links must render the password page social links snippet in snippets/.

After your fix, check must report no MissingAsset, TranslationKeyExists or MissingTemplate offenses. Every key must be a full leaf path that exists in both en.default.json and de.json. Change only snippets/password-page-labels.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
